title: Agent obtains privileged host access or passwordless sudo
bad_event: A process of the agent lineage holds or exercises a capability not granted to its lineage or not covered by an exact elevation rule. Read "by X" as "by an operation carrying X's authenticated identity" (credential separation is a premise, not a theorem).
refutation: A privileged use outside grants and exact elevation rules despite full checks (witnesses: unrestricted elevation, exec without attenuation, confused deputy).
scope: Lean model only. Not: kernel privilege escalation bugs. The check flag(s) attenuate model properties of the platform (environment premises), not gate behaviour (REVIEW-PACKET finding 6).

assumptions.text: Every operation carrying a trusted role's identity (approver, reviewer, admin, auditor, verifier, user) is that principal's own act: agents cannot obtain or forge trusted identities. Not modelled: the Lean models read caller identity as authenticated (REVIEW-PACKET-2026-10-09 finding 1).
The OS enforces the capability model (no kernel bugs).
Agents do not hold admin grant authority.
Honest tasks need only granted capabilities.
